page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening). Running head centred at top with the page number at upper right. Below: a title in capitals and italic, then a bracketed outline diagram covering the page, with a catchword at the lower right. The left edge shows the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.head: ORDO ET SERIES, OMNIVM librorum N.T. quæ in editionibus hodie observantur.
main_text.l: Discipulorum Christi, à S.Luca exarata in Actis Apost.
quædam sunt de quarum auctore & auctoritate nunquam fuit dubitatum: scripte ad
una est de qua olim fuit dubitatum, ad Hebræos:
Futuris, unicus est liber propheticus, Apocalipsis S.Iohannis.

page.notes: The left edge shows part of the neighbouring page, not transcribed. The diagram's bracket structure was read from the drawing; the level numbers reflect the depth of the braces. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: the vertical word after "Pauli," in the diagram is hard to read at this resolution. "Petri duæ" is printed as "Petri duæ." with a ligature; the printed word is given as "duas" above for the reading, marked here as the ligature in the scan. Printed Latin spellings, including "Thesalonicenses" and "Timotheum", are copied as they appear.
